text: After my knee injury I'll get back to training slowly, but first I'll see a physiotherapist and buy new running shoes.
We will sell our car and use car sharing and an e-bike instead.
I'm buying an electric car and installing a heat pump.
We'll insulate the house, replace the old gas boiler and collect rainwater for the garden.
I'm going to start therapy, meditate every morning and get more sleep.
I'll get a flu shot, book a dental appointment and use sunscreen every day.
We are moving to a small town, I will work remotely and we'll grow our own vegetables.
We're buying a house with a mortgage, taking out home insurance and getting a kitten.
I will cancel my Netflix subscription and read more books.
I'm going to quit my job, start my own business and work longer hours for a while.
My company is moving to a four-day week, so I'll learn to play the guitar and take a pottery class.
I'll sell my old stuff at a flea market and get my shoes repaired.
I'm going to cycle to work in summer, take the bus in winter and always wear a helmet.
I'll eat less meat, cook at home more often and drink fewer soft drinks.
I'm going vegan and I'll buy organic vegetables at the farmers market.
We're having a baby next year, so I'll take paternity leave and buy a child seat for the car.
I'm going to get married, sign a prenup and move in with my partner.
I'll put part of my salary into an index fund every month, build an emergency fund and buy shares in a few companies.
I want to pay off my credit card debt, keep a household budget and claim child benefit.
I'll start a private pension and buy some Bitcoin.
I'm going to volunteer at a food bank, give blood twice a year and donate to charity.
I will vote in the referendum, sign a petition for cleaner air and organise a street party with my neighbours.
I'll limit my kids' screen time, our youngest will start kindergarten, and the older one will go to a Montessori school.
I'm going to learn to code, use AI tools at work and set up a password manager.
I'll learn a new language with Duolingo, spend a semester abroad with Erasmus and share a flat with two flatmates.
I'm going to adopt a dog from an animal shelter.
This summer we'll travel by train instead of flying, stay at a campsite and go fishing at the lake.
Next year I'll take a sabbatical and travel the world.
I'll ask for a raise, join the trade union and take on a side job.
I'm switching to hybrid work, moving closer to the office and getting a standing desk.
I'm going to quit smoking, lose some weight and sign up at a fitness club.
We're going to renovate the kitchen, buy a dishwasher and fit smoke alarms.
I'm going to get a smart thermostat, switch to LED bulbs and turn off the lights when I leave a room.
I'll drink tap water, carry a reusable bottle and recycle more.
I'm going to cut down on alcohol, walk more and play football with friends every week.
I'll write a will and take out life insurance.
I'm taking my former employer to court, reporting the fraud to the police and writing about it on my blog.
We're going to adopt a child, I'll work part-time and my wife will go back to work.
My elderly mother moves in with us, so I'll take a first aid course.
I'm going to delete my Instagram.
